PRESTIGE ACQUIRES 50% STAKE IN ADVENT FOR ₹500 CR

Prestige Estates Projects Ltd acquired an indirect 50% stake in Advent Convention and Hotels International for about Rs 500 crore. The acquisition was made through its wholly‑owned subsidiary, creating a joint venture for a commercial development in Andheri, Mumbai. The project covers 21,978.22 square meters with an estimated 1.50 million square feet of leasable space and a gross development value of roughly Rs 4,500 crore, expanding Prestige’s footprint in Mumbai’s real‑estate market.
